theme: Last day sailing the Adriatic — the long trip home starts tomorrow.
greeting: You're on the water for one more day off the Croatian coast, Dan. Tomorrow you disembark at Komolac and begin the journey back to Florida, so the loose ends worth closing now are all about landing smoothly.

needsAttention.title: Rental car for Sunday's TPA landing
needsAttention.detail: Full-size SUV, TPA, Sept 20–Oct 5 is still unbooked. You land Sunday at 3:55 PM — lock it in now rather than facing walk-up rates, jet-lagged, on a Sunday.

needsAttention.title: St Pete nights, Sept 20–21
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sunday but the kids aren't picked up until Tuesday. Two nights near St Pete before the Orlando villa are still open — the last gap in the trip.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat disembark logistics
needsAttention.detail: You're off the boat at noon tomorrow at Komolac. The transfer to Cavtat, a bag hold before the 3 PM check-in, and Sunday's ~5:15 AM early checkout all need arranging while you have signal ashore.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week — thin holiday inventory that sells out, and the Pathfinder heads south in October so there's no six-seater up north otherwise.

inbox.noise: A quiet inbox — no new primary mail in the last two days while you've been at sea.

recipe.title: Pumpkin chiffon pie
recipe.why: Autumn's squash and warm spices are at their peak now.

tasks.title: Buy Disney park tickets for the Sept 26–27 weekend

acts.line: Your last morning aboard off the Dalmatian coast — no calls, no calendar, just the sail back toward Dubrovnik.
The charter winds down with nothing scheduled ashore, so the day's real work is landing-day bookings, not meetings.
Last night on the boat before an early disembark — worth confirming tomorrow's Cavtat transfer while you still have a connection.
